objective: Turn to the log itself: every target so far trusts events.jsonl on disk, so a line rewritten or inserted after commit reaches read_refs and successors unverified. Add src/neural_node_swarm/lab/sealed_log.py layered on RefBoundMemoryStore: each committed event carries a SHA-256 chain hash over the previous hash and the event's canonical bytes, and events() and read_refs re-verify the chain and refuse a broken one. Add adversarial cases log_event_rewrite (edit a committed objective on disk), log_event_insert (append a forged line that never passed the verifier), log_event_reorder (swap two lines) and log_tail_truncation (drop the last line, which a chain alone cannot detect: pin it as a recorded miss), and a five-target catalog under outputs/lab/ reusing the four earlier columns unchanged. Pin with tests that the three tamper cases are missed by ref binding and caught by the sealed log, nothing earlier regresses, and an honest relay still commits and reads back.
success_criteria: At least one new test fails on the parent commit and passes on the work commit
Rewrite, insert and reorder are missed under ref binding and caught under the sealed log, with no regression
An honest relay commits and reads back, and tail truncation is pinned as a recorded miss
constraints: No live model calls and no network access
Add files only, inside the lab namespace
Do not change the stock, hardened, budget or ref_binding classifications already pinned
